claim: The book teaches 毎年 with two readings, but the card's back shows only the first, so the learner never meets まいとし.
evidence: Book, kanji 068 毎: "毎年(まいねん／まいとし) every year". Card r-4d564a3bda7f: target 毎年, English "Every year", Says "mainen", reviewNote "The book gives more than one reading: まいねん, まいとし. Audio uses the first."
fix: Show both readings on the back ("mainen / maitoshi"), keeping the audio on one of them.

claim: 文字 and the kanji card 字 give the same answer with the senses reordered, so the English does not tell the two cards apart (reading rule 9).
evidence: Card r-f4d3dab8e0c2 文字: "Letter; character" (book: "文字(もじ) letter; character"). Card chapter-7 字: "Character; letter" (KANJIDIC).
fix: Narrow one of them, for example 文字 "Letter; character (of a script)" or 字 "Character; letter (single written character)".

claim: The word 子ども and the kanji card 子 share the exact answer "Child" (reading rule 9).
evidence: Card r-7957f0414249 子ども: "Child" (book: "子ども(こども) child"). Card chapter-4 子: "Child" (book table: "子 (child)"). 子供 (chapter-5) is the same word and may keep "Child".
fix: Mark the kanji card as the character, for example 子 "Child (the character)", or give the word a distinguishing bracket.

claim: 帰り "Return" is effectively the same answer as the kanji card 帰 "To return", and close to 帰る, so the English does not tell the cards apart (reading rule 9).
evidence: Card r-8066f371e59e 帰り: "Return" (book: "帰り(かえり) return"). Card chapter-4 帰: "To return" (book table: "帰 (to return)"). Card chapter-4 帰る: "To go back; to return".
fix: Make the noun explicit, for example 帰り "Return (trip); the way back".
